folders.basis: native name of batocera, and systems of ep128emu_core

name: RetroBat
notes: ~ is the EmulationStation home, <RetroBat>\emulationstation, so ~\..\roms is <RetroBat>\roms beside <RetroBat>\bios.
A file is a game only when its lowercased extension is in the folder's list (es es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:355).
Default core: the core marked default, else the first emulator's first core (es es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:1923-1960).
